Hooray, my first post! Let's see if I can get any of this right :)

>1)Form of mist, continue action at +1 stealth.
>
>If its the same action, can the vampire that was in combat attempt to
>block again, just as if it was part of the stealth/interecept auction?
>

No. Because he successfully blocked, which tapped him. Then FoM is played
to end combat and continue the action - but it doesn't mention untapping
the blocking minion. So you can still block it with someone else, if they
can provide enough intercept.

>2)the Sleeping Mind , causes enemy to be unable to untap at superior
>for this action
>
>But the wake cards say you can attempt to block and react as if
>untapped, so you can still play these cards and do so correct?
>

You can still Wake because you aren't untapping, you're only acting as
though you did untap.

>Which makes the sleeping mind onlly useful versus the animalsim untap
>cards iirc.
>

And Second Tradition, of course :)

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>1)Form of mist, continue action at +1 stealth.
>
>If its the same action, can the vampire that was in combat attempt to
>block again, just as if it was part of the stealth/interecept auction?

If the vampire that just blocked is still untapped (and ready), he can still
block. In addition, remember that intercept cards he played earlier still
apply. Also, Wakes and Forceds last for the entire action so if the vampire is
tapped but played a Wake to block the first time around, the Wake is still in
effect (and he can still block again).

>2)the Sleeping Mind , causes enemy to be unable to untap at superior
>for this action
>
>But the wake cards say you can attempt to block and react as if
>untapped, so you can still play these cards and do so correct?

You can still use Wakes to block when the acting minion uses superior Sleeping
Mind. The text about tapped vampires not being able to block is just supposed
to be a reminder of the normal rules. Note that in addition to countering
animalism untaps, it is also effective against Eternal Vigilence and the very
commonly seen 2nd Tradition.

Halcyan 2
